CustomField.description: REV-57: optional suffix appended after the month/year on a Default_Form_Name__c (e.g. Newsfeed = "MQL" → "... - June 2026 - MQL"). Blank = no suffix. Only used when Parse_Form_Name_From_Subject__c is FALSE and Default_Form_Name__c is set.
CustomField.label: Form Name Suffix
